t: This is Walton House, including Upper Walton House, in the SW1X part of Kensington and Chelsea. It was designed by Richard Norman Shaw, a British architect who worked from the 1870s to the 1900s. He is considered among the greatest of British architects, known for his country houses and for commercial buildings. His influence on architectural style was strongest in the 1880s and 1890s. I don't have more detail on the house itself, so the best thing to do is look at the building and think of it as the work of one of Britain's most influential architects.
